node.statement: Product right inverse: approximate associativity gives ||L_X-L_U L_V||<=e||U||||V||<=e/(1-e)<1/5. The operator A:=L_U L_V is invertible by the common multiplier node and ||A^{-1}||<=49/16, so ||A^{-1}(L_X-A)||<49/80<1. The Neumann perturbation lemma makes L_X invertible; therefore R_X:=L_X^{-1}J satisfies X bold-dot R_X=J and is a right inverse of X.
